guard: Temporary source-owned pull journals preserve stock authentication and export only bounded private-equality projections.
command: pnpm --filter @cotal-ai/core build && pnpm --filter @cotal-ai/auth build && pnpm smoke:diagnostic-auth-journal && pnpm smoke:diagnostic-auth-journal:live
why: DJL cells use genuine CotalEndpoint.start and the shipped callout against a real operator-mode broker. No copied authentication handler or seeded expected-output journal is used.

DJ unit cells call the same shipped journal classes and fixture join. They cover receiver/result/error conservation, fixed bounds, overflow, repeated response stages and privacy. They do not substitute for the real broker reachability cells.
All commands build actual changed packages, and each afterRestore rebuilds and reruns its command. Definitions are source-prepared only. No local baseline, kill or restoration was executed.
Live-targeted mutants run the live suite directly so a unit failure cannot prevent reaching the named DJL assertion. Baseline suite command still includes both layers.
